# Trusted Locksmith

> Locksmith marketplace operated by PlanetHike OÜ. Trusted Locksmith publishes standard prices and scope before a customer requests a participating independent local provider.

Canonical site: https://trustedlocksmithnearme.com
Primary launch market: Boston and Greater Boston, Massachusetts
Expanded geographic content: New York City plus selected New York State markets
Business model: marketplace platform; field work is performed by independent providers
Homepage model: market-neutral hero followed immediately by location choice

## Customer rules
- Standard price and scope are shown before the request.
- Provider travel/service call is included in published standard totals.
- Provider identity and ETA appear only after a real participating provider accepts.
- Additional out-of-scope work or hardware must be priced and approved before it starts.
- One-off locksmith service does not require membership.
- A geographic or service page does not guarantee that a provider is currently available at every address or hour.

## Current standard services
- Home lockout, weekdays 8am–6pm: $99
- Home lockout, evenings/weekends: $129
- Home lockout, overnight/major holidays: $139
- Car lockout at the property: $109
- Standard rekey: $75 for provider travel/service call plus first standard cylinder; additional standard cylinders $29 each
- Standard lock change: $89 standard labor; hardware separate
- Smart lock installation: $129 standard labor for one compatible customer-supplied smart lock

## Property and business use cases
Trusted Locksmith connects one-off local locksmith intent with repeat property-access workflows where the service is genuinely relevant.

- Property managers: resident lockouts, turnover rekeys, lock changes and property/unit service history.
- Landlords: tenant-turnover rekeys, rental-property access records and repeat locksmith coordination.
- Real estate professionals: move-in rekeying, lock changes or compatible smart-lock installation after closing; separate brokerage Digital Access gifting is also available.
- Second-home owners: rekeying, lock changes, smart access and local locksmith coordination when the owner is not on site.
- These business/property pages do not imply that PlanetHike OÜ performs locksmith field work. Participating independent providers perform field service.

## Local SEO and internal relationships
Trusted Locksmith publishes city and city/service pages for Boston and selected Greater Boston/Massachusetts markets. New York geography includes 28 localized pages covering New York City, five boroughs, selected NYC neighborhoods, Westchester/Hudson Valley markets, Long Island county hubs and major Upstate New York cities.

New York service expansion adds 92 evidence-gated service/location pages:
- emergency locksmith: 28 locations
- car lockout: 22 locations
- rekey locks: 20 locations
- lock change: 14 locations
- smart lock installation: 8 locations

Local rekey, lock-change and smart-lock pages link to relevant property-manager, landlord, real-estate and second-home workflows. Their WebPage structured data also includes relatedLink relationships to those strategic pages. Geography pages link down to relevant services and across to nearby/related locations.

House-lockout pages are not multiplied across New York because the current search evidence is weak and overlaps heavily with emergency-locksmith intent. Automotive pages remain vehicle-entry only and do not claim key cutting or programming. The sitemap is the canonical route inventory.
